Delta-only review: readWorkspaceDiff is a focused domain reader behind the existing coding route and repository snapshot boundary, not a new cross-subsystem abstraction. Browser-test-evidence mutation ownership/restoration claims remain correct: only two case registrations and child-process classification were added. Task room, workspace directory and checkpoint owners are unchanged. The workspace context owns the new diff scope/limits; no module-map prose or shipped MCP meaning changes.

Reviewed Task exact directory -> shared DiffPanel -> SDK string request -> coding GET/git/diff -> confined snapshot -> readWorkspaceDiff. Documented index-relative tracked edits plus non-ignored untracked additions, empty/binary representation, no staging/index/object writes, explicit whole-read refusals and actual byte/count/time/scan limits. Actual route three-file regression failed before the fix; route/real Task renderer, safety and preserved File Preview tests passed. This is source/focused evidence, not R6 or published-candidate qualification.
